title: Second headset test: faster stand-in spawns, muzzle flash away from the eyes, drones from both sides
acceptance: Stand-in levels keep steady pressure (shorter spawn gaps and slots)
Muzzle flash sits further from the eye, smaller and dimmer, and does not strobe every shot at 10 shots/s; reduced-flash still reduces it
Stand-in levels send drones from the left lane as well as the right
All ETM tests pass; APK installed on the Quest 3
Cannon mounts wider apart so they read as being at the player's sides
description: Owner feedback, 2026-11-18, after the full campaign loop: enemies spawn a little slow; the circle of light at the muzzle is too close to the eyes when turning to shoot drones; drones only come from one side (owner chose to add the left side in the stand-ins; bible layouts keep flyers on the right for the real arenas).

history.note: Owner checked the changes on the Quest 3 and approved in chat. Recorded on the owner's behalf by claude-code-dartonx-pc.

result.summary: Faster stand-in spawns (gaps 1.5-2.5 s, shorter slots), drones from left and right, muzzle flash 40 cm past the muzzle at half size, dimmer and at most every 0.25 s, cannon mounts 65 cm to each side. Branch stacked on t-0031.
result.verification: All 83 ETM tests pass (new: rapid-fire flash rate/position, stand-in spawn gaps and drone lanes); APK installed on the Quest 3. Owner headset check pending.
